name: hcoll_v5_qcap

fill_reason.pin_bound: 1096 pin bits balanced uniformly (pin_balance, M4) over W/E 124.6 um = 0.23 um pitch (2.4 tracks, 21% of M4 tracks); 25.92 wide so the E pin-flop band (io_flop_at_pins, outputs only) fits <= 45% of the core; std 184 um2 -> low util is pin-bound by design.

job.purpose: hard_v5 COLL qslots pin_v2 capture leaf (NS1 PWT545, 547 FF), shared master: 11x in q3, 9x in q2; every output a flop Q.

pin_regs.reason: Actual RTL already registers every port at the face: capture leaf src_d->captured, src_v->src_v_p, capture_slot->captured_slot (outputs captured/captured_slot/fault are flop Q). Recipe-2 output stage on: io_flop_at_pins anchors only the OUTPUT launch flops at their pins (OT_OFLOP_PORT_RE), pin_reg_split + keep_pin_regs give one launch flop per output pin; inputs keep their inhold pad.

structural_change: Native audit FAIL on routed CLOSED hcoll_v5_qcap-qs1045-f5c09abd9 (physical/ref_tile/hcoll_v5_qcap/native_audit.json on main 9b52246fc): TT launch 240.4 > 220 ps on 32 captured[*] outputs (110 > 200), capture 126.5 / spread 10 / R 95.7 pass. Cause: 1,095 pins at minimum PPL pitch on a 17.28-um strip with io_flop_at_pins OFF, so launch flops sat away from their E pins. Fix (H-NETLIST/COLL coordinator 10-16): outline 17.28x99.36 -> 25.92x129.6, pins balanced uniformly (0.23 um pitch), output launch flops FIRM at their E pins (io_flop_at_pins, OT_OFLOP_PORT_RE outputs only), pin_reg_split + keep_pin_regs; same RTL and pin faces.
